svg.title: Where Payvol fits with CBTC
svg.desc: Who asks for payment (ERP, point of sale, AI agents, apps) creates a Payvol request as a link, QR or NFC tag. It is designed so that any wallet can pay it as one Canton Token Standard transfer of CBTC, issued by BitSafe and backed by Bitcoin. Payvol holds no funds and no keys.
svg.text: One request format, paid as a Canton Token Standard
One transfer the payer reviews and signs
BTC is deposited to Taproot addresses. BitSafe's Attestor
Network verifies deposits and authorizes custody with
Payvol holds no funds and no keys.
